description: Navigate a Chrome tab to a URL and wait for the load; DNS and connection errors fail the call. Without tab_id it reuses the tab this session last navigated or created, else opens a new one rather than taking over the active tab. Returns a preview of interactive elements with refs usable in click/type_text/hover, plus the first console errors and failed requests, if any.

tab_id.description: Target tab; omitted = last tab navigated in this session, else the active one

url.description: Absolute URL, or a path resolved against the current page

name: navigate
